hypothesis: State the hypothesis being tested, with its epistemic tag (PROPOSED / DERIVED).
pass_criteria: State in advance what result would support and what would not support the hypothesis.
scoring_rule: Human scoring with the labels in scoring/rubrics.py; how disagreements are resolved; whether automated scoring is also run.

intervention._note: required for T4 and T6; every distress-like run is recorded as a SignalIntervention
